title: add release manifests, SBOM generation, and cosign signing to private-installer CI
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: private-installer releases are consumed by air-gapped and regulated customers and must include verifiable provenance and signed artifacts. This PR adds automated SBOM generation (syft), deterministic release manifest generation, and cosign artifact signing into the private-installer CI pipeline so each release has a signed manifest + SBOM bundle and verifiable provenance.

What this changes: 1) CI workflows: new .github/workflows/release-manifests.yml that runs on release tags and on manual_dispatch; builds installer artifacts (helm charts, terraform modules, installer binaries), runs syft to produce SBOMs, and runs cosign to produce signatures for each artifact and for the generated release-manifest.json. 2) release tooling: scripts/release/generate_release_manifest.sh which collects artifact checksums, SBOM locations, and image digests and emits a deterministic manifest with canonical ordering for reproducibility. 3) signing helpers: scripts/release/cosign_sign.sh wrapper that handles key retrieval from the artifacts KMS or falls back to ephemeral CI key, and uploads signature blobs to the release bucket. 4) Helm/Terraform: small Helm chart versioning tweaks and added chart provenance fields; terraform/modules/private_installer/outputs.tf includes module checksums so the manifest can reference module artifacts. 5) Docs: docs/release/README.md with instructions for manual verification and key rotation.

Compatibility and rollout: new workflow is additive and gated behind the release tag; for existing releases the pipeline will not overwrite past manifests. The signing step is optional (controlled via RELEASE_SIGN=true) to support early adoption and key rollout.

Testing performed: unit tests for manifest generator; e2e smoke run in CI that builds artifacts and verifies signatures against a test cosign key; manual verification documented in PR.

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps provenance metadata compact (artifact name, sha256, size, sbom_location, signature_location) to make automated ingestion by partner systems simple. Future work (ENG-6302) will add OCI-based attestations.
